review_scope: Readiness gate only; no receipts, outputs, approvals, amendment hash, or execution authority are fabricated.

deterministic_receipts.reason: The draft contains descriptive edge strings, but no executable GraphState/effective memory snapshot fixture. The repository retriever requires those concrete inputs to produce receipts.

context_packet_stability.reason: The draft context strings are declarations, not canonical packets emitted from receipt-linked source records.

model_parameters_fingerprint.reason: The local /models endpoint exposes model ID and ownership only; it does not expose model weights or a parameter fingerprint.

sampling_fingerprint.reason: LocalLMStudioBrain sends only model, messages, and stream=false. Temperature, top_p, seed, max_tokens, and server defaults are not recorded or discoverable from the /models response.

human_approval_records.reason: Human approval records cannot be synthesized or inferred from design pre-approval. Each record must bind a reviewed exact arm to its receipt, snapshot, source packet, policy revision, and single-use scope.

required_next_artifacts: executable synthetic GraphState and effective snapshot fixture
canonical source-linked context packet for every arm
verified model parameter or model-weight fingerprint
verified sampling fingerprint including all server defaults
final one-factor-only validation report over actual artifacts
human pair decisions limited to APPROVED_FOR_EXECUTION or REJECTED
